          Please review and agree before you continue.

          Read the BeAIReadyCo School Privacy Notice

          Who we are. BeAIReadyCo runs live, project-based AI classes for kids ages 8 and up, in person and online, with families, schools, after-school programs, community centers, libraries and other organizations. You can reach us at beaireadyco@gmail.com.

          What we collect. Parent or guardian name and email address. Child first name, last name or initial, nickname, and a student ID we assign. Class and group, and class attendance. Learning activity: projects and quizzes, and sometimes printed materials for extra activities. Messages sent by email, phone or the BeAIReadyCo app. We do not ask for a child's birthday, address, phone number or photo without your permission.

          Why. To run classes, show a child's progress to their parent, and send messages about classes. We do not use this information for advertising, and we do not sell it.

          Who can see it. You, the teacher for your child's class, BeAIReadyCo staff who run the program, and a partner school or organization where applicable.

          Consent. We ask for your consent before we collect your child's information. You can review, correct or delete your child's information at any time, and withdraw your consent by emailing beaireadyco@gmail.com.

          Children and accounts. Children do not sign in with Google or any other outside account. Once you create the family account, you can add your child by name, an email address and a password. The admin approves the new family and child, and then you and your child can sign in.

          How long we keep information. We keep a child's records while they are enrolled, and delete them after a parent asks.

          Keeping information safe. We limit access to people who need it for the class and protect accounts with sign-in. Tell us right away if you think your account has been used without your permission.

          Changes. If we change how we handle information, we will update this notice.

          Contact. Marina Pinhas, Founder, BeAIReadyCo. beaireadyco@gmail.com

          Your account needs approval from BeAIReadyCo before you can log in.
